title: Evergreen Note Promotion Funnel
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=note:link note_stage=*
| stats count by note_stage
| eventstats sum(count) as total
| eval pct=round(100*count/total,1)
| sort - count
description: Breaks down how many notes remain fleeting, become literature notes, or graduate to evergreen notes.
value: A second brain improves when more notes make it to synthesis, not when raw capture volume simply grows.
implementation: Tag note stages in note-graph exports and summarize the distribution across your note funnel.
visualization: Funnel table of notes by stage.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how many notes grow from rough jottings into the useful long-term ideas you can build on later.
